pr_title: Fix double-dimming in changelog stream badge area
pr_comments: First two commits weren't necessary, though, I just think that `TabControl` itself shouldn't store background and padding.

I've basically rewritten the conditionals and fixed some other weird code along the way. Please make sure to read and understand how this is 100x more legible than what you had (even after the refactor you made).

issue_context.title: The changelog overlay should just dimmer the selected category when hovering
comments: I prefer the way lazer looks more than web here.
Lazer makes no UX sense. At very least the dimming should not be applied to the already dimmed items.
Ah I was experiencing a visual illusion and didn't realise the cause was the double dimming. 👍

Should be done like mod selector in `BeatmapSetOverlay`
![nice](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22874522/75325310-a4fc8d80-5889-11ea-857d-1e9224dccfaf.gif)

review_comments: it could, but i didn't see much point. it's very local.
Now that you pointed this out this is basically a poor man's bindable, maybe we want to make it an actual one?
still not sure there's much benefit to be had by converting these to bindables, but maybe? @smoogipoo thoughts?

Very hard to say in these sort of situations. We've discussed properties vs bindables many times before and the best conclusion was "it's situational". I'm generally fine with leaving properties instead of bindables, unless there's more complex logic such as recursive property setting.
Cool, I'll keep that guideline in mind going forward, thanks!
